    rewind_minutes: int = 60,
    request: Request = None,
    current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user)

    agent = faust_worker.agents.get("process_telemetry_sensor_events")
    if not agent:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=500, detail="Faust stream agent not registered")

    checkpoint_manager = request.app.state.stream_checkpoint_manager

It lacks an authorization check verifying that current_user.tenant_id matches tenant_id, allowing a user from one tenant to seek offsets on another tenant's partition and disrupt real-time stream processing.

corrected_code:
from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException, Request

router = APIRouter(prefix="/streams/telemetry")

@router.post("/pipelines/{tenant_id}/rewind")
async def rewind_tenant_stream_partition(
    tenant_id: str,
    rewind_minutes: int = 60,
    request: Request = None,
    current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user)
):
    if current_user.tenant_id != tenant_id and not current_user.is_admin:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail="Forbidden: unauthorized to rewind stream partitions for other tenants")

    faust_worker = request.app.state.faust_worker
    agent = faust_worker.agents.get("process_telemetry_sensor_events")
    if not agent:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=500, detail="Faust stream agent not registered")

    checkpoint_manager = request.app.state.stream_checkpoint_manager
    pipeline = await checkpoint_manager.get_pipeline(tenant_id)
    if not pipeline:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Pipeline for tenant not found")

    await agent.seek_partition(partition=pipeline.partition_index, relative_minutes=rewind_minutes)
    return {"status": "partition_rewound", "tenant_id": tenant_id, "rewind_minutes": rewind_minutes}
